name: Hist-Marked Champion
material_note: RI-WPN05 §B: 'plant / root — Hist-bonded champions'. The Hist has taken the limbs; the man is still wearing his cuirass and still has his face. Three materials on one body, and each of them changes which weapon you want.
_water_note: RI-WLD10 §5 R5 (S25). Hist-bonded and rooted in the mire, but the material note's own 'still wearing his cuirass' is two of three body regions of plain metal armour — a champion wades deeper than an ordinary levy (W3, not W2) but is not declared water_native: it does not swim, and R6's DPS-floor promise is reserved for the roster's actually-aquatic archetypes.

weapon._socket_rule_note: socket_a_dist_m is skeleton.json §weapon.socket_rule's grip_offset_m (0.10) because socket_a is wpn_guard. It was 0.30-0.45 in wave 1, which put the near end of the hitbox a third of a metre past the hands and gave every enemy a dead ring in front of its own chest that no pose could close (W1-09 round-4 measurement: min_axis 0.67-0.93 m). capsule_length_m follows from the two sockets.
weapon._peak_declared_note: RI-CMB04 §B declares peak_tip_speed_mps per PLAYER weapon class and nothing for enemies, so the enemy clips were the one part of the build no speed ceiling applied to. Adopted from the §B row whose capsule_length_m is nearest this weapon's (ultra_greatsword, 1.7 m). PROVISIONAL: RI-CMB04 owns the column and may re-derive it.

parley.fiction: The champion is honour_bound: she will not accept a yield from someone who is beating her. She can be bought at a price only a rich player has, she answers to rank 6 in her own order, and she will stand down for anyone who speaks the name of the ford.

provenance.identity: The RI-CMB07 exemplar's opponent. 2876 HP is the exemplar's own figure, which is not frame data and therefore survives the S22 invalidation.
provenance.frame_data: PROVISIONAL. Enemy windup and punish-window design is RI-AI02/RI-AI03 and wave-1 piece W1-12. All values f@60.
provenance.poise: 48 rather than RI-CMB05 §A's cited 28: the corpus figure predates this build's poise-pool arithmetic (poise_health_max = 20 + armour_poise), under which 28 would mean armour_poise 8 and a champion that a single straight-sword R1 (22 poise damage, resisted to 22) staggers every other swing. 48 gives it 28 of armour poise and two swings of standing. Flagged as a divergence rather than silently adopted.

_armour_rating_note: Seam S19's consuming system for `corrode` (RI-MAG06 §B: "the rating falls"). A flat subtraction from every incoming damage number, applied in combat/resolve.js at the one site damage is computed. It was 0 everywhere in wave 1, which meant `corrode` had nothing to corrode and measured NOT_OBSERVED. Provisional: RI-CMB01 owns armour as a fight quantity and may re-derive every figure here.
_reactable_note: RI-CMB12 §A: `reactable` is DECLARED HERE, IN ADVANCE, and counts against the archetype's `reactable_share` (>= 0.70). An attack declaring `true` must measure `t_react = f_active - f_vis >= 19 f@60`, where f_vis is the frame the POSE first becomes distinguishable — not the frame the state label changes. Measured by tools/harness/cmb-exchange.mjs --probe react.
_s5_note: W1-13 r2. The two fog-gate bosses declare their own S5 classification. game/data/world/respawn.json's never_respawn_entity_flags is the enumeration; engine._classifyOnSpawn() copies any of them a statblock declares onto the entity, so a boss is content by DATA rather than because a caller remembered to pass {boss:true}. never_respawn_ids still lists both — two independent guards on the same fact, which is the fail-closed direction seam S5 asks for.
_souls_note: DERIVED by tools/progression/derive-soul-values.mjs from this statblock's own hp/poise/armour_rating/attack_rating/tier, scaled by RI-PRG06 §7's census normalisation (576/world.enemy_census, read from corpus/00-doctrine/constants.json) — do not hand-edit, re-run the tool (it has a --check mode that fails if the field and the derivation have drifted, and binds the value to the band of the region the statblock is actually placed in). Read by game/src/sim/souls.js, which is the ONLY producer of soulsHeld apart from recovering your own bloodstain. RI-PRG06 §3 owns the soul budget, RI-PRG01 owns the curve it is spent on, and seam S15 forbids souls buying anything but a level. Props are zero so a 99,999-hp training dummy is not an infinite farm.
